errors.evidence: The description transcribes the x-axis label as 'Директор на отдела' (Director of the department), but the actual label in the chart is 'Директор на отдел' (Director of department).
The description misspells the x-axis label 'Вицепрезидент' (Vice President) as 'Вицепрзидент'.

There is a grammatical error in the phrase 'стойностите са означена'. The subject 'стойностите' (the values) is plural, so the adjective should be in its plural form 'означени', not the singular form 'означена'.
